title: Make a field required with a SQLite migration
prompt: The app keeps its data in SQLite and deploys with migrations (see migrations/). Every note should now have a color: make the `color` field of notes required with the default "gray", so existing notes without a color get "gray". Update the model, and add the migration file migrations/0002_color_required.sql that `inferlo db migrate color_required --allow-change` would generate for this SQLite app (SQLite cannot change a column in place, so the table is rebuilt), and update migrations/snapshot.json the same way, so that running `inferlo db migrate` afterwards finds no changes. You cannot run commands.
